content: In the SoAd_MainFunction() the SoAd shall process as specified below if the SoAd receive buffer contains TP data for a socket connection with PDU Header mode disabled: (1) Query the available amount of data at the upper layer by calling the configurable callback function <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]CopyRxData() with PduInfoType.SduLength = 0. (2) Copy all data belonging to this socket connection from the SoAd receive buffer which can be accepted by the upper layer module determined at (1) to the upper lay er by calling <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]CopyRxData()
